name: Do I need to replace all my door casings at once, or can I do it in stages?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to replace all my door casings at once, or can I do it in stages?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not necessarily need to replace all your door casings at once; the project can be completed in stages based on your budget or renovation timeline. Many homeowners choose to tackle one room or floor at a time to manage costs and minimize disruption. However, doing all casings at once can sometimes be more efficient and may ensure a consistent look if you are upgrading styles across your entire home. Discussing your phasing preferences allows us to plan effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing door casings can be done in stages based on budget or timeline, though doing it all at once can be more efficient for consistency.
